answer: The inlet counter is kept in delta and walnut reveals each reset. An adversary thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 544 identities would post 1847 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
